description:
Survey harness crates under `dev/active/` reach `dev/tools/tuning-campaign-support` and workspace crates through Cargo path dependencies relative to their own directory. Cargo 1.95 offers no depth-independent form without repository-wide lockfile effects, so these dependencies are a named exception to `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`, and a move rewrites them.

## Background

Evaluated forms: a `[patch]` table in the repository `.cargo/config.toml`, the same table in a separate file passed with `--config`, and a fixed-location harness workspace. The convergence condition is tracked by issue 58a4bb51.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A linked record names the exception `harness-path-dependencies` to `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`, states its scope (Cargo `path` dependencies in survey harness manifests), the rule a move follows (rewrite the path text to the new depth and rebuild), and the convergence condition with its tracking issue.
- [hard] REQ-02: The record shows why each evaluated form is rejected, by exact commands on Rust 1.95 and their committed outputs.
- [hard] REQ-03: The record gives the command that lists every harness manifest carrying such a dependency, and holds no hand-copied list or count.
- [hard] REQ-04: No manifest, lockfile or configuration file changes.

## Decisions

- DEC-01: The owner decided on 2026-10-03 that the scope covers every path dependency of the harness crates and approved a `[patch]` table in the repository `.cargo/config.toml`.
- DEC-02: The owner decided on 2026-10-03, on the evidence that the `[patch]` form breaks `--locked` resolution of the root lockfile and of most tracked harness lockfiles, that harness path dependencies are a named, tracked exception and that each move rewrites them. DEC-02 supersedes DEC-01.
title: Record the harness path-dependency exception
